newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends at 35.73/74 on higher dlr supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends at 35.73/74 on higher dlr supply.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.73/74 on Friday compared to the opening level of 35.74/75 as dollar supply improved, dealers said.
Most of the day's deals were at 35.74 level, they said.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was in the market buying dollars at 35.7350, dealers said. RBI bought dollars dollars at this level on Wednesday but abstained from market on Thursday.
"The supply was more (than demand) today," said a dealer at a state-run bank in Bombay.
Dealers said the dollar demand trend and RBI's current buying levels suggested the rupee was unlikely to appreciate.
Some dealers said they were expecting further demand for dollars in the coming weeks.
"We may see the rupee touch a low of 35.80 in the coming weeks or at least in December," said a dealer.
The forward dollar market saw minor fluctuation in premia on Friday, dealers said.
